name: 2025-1c-parcial2
title: Painter (Pintor)
description: Model of a screen-painting tool: a painter places rectangular paintings on a wall, selects several of them, aligns the selection left or right, and can undo/redo every action through a consistent history. The student designs everything from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Undo/redo asks for reified actions (command objects) and a history whose invariants (no undo without actions, no redo without undo, discard redo list on a new action) must be kept, plus the left/right alignment symmetry invites removing duplication; the starting file has no model code, only the category and exam-control patches.
